summary: Builds the global active-vehicle pointer array: scans every vehicle slot from unk_5EC6D8 up to byte_7C54D8 and appends each slot whose dword at index 3250 is not -1 into dword_7C54F0 (VehiclePtrArray). If fewer than 104 vehicles were collected, zero-fills the unused array tail, then backfills remaining slots with live vehicles not already listed. Finally records the array indices of two reference vehicle pointers as dword_7C54DC (CurrentPlayerIndex) and dword_7C54E4 (CurrentVehicleIndex). Returns the number of active vehicles.

local_names.v0: count of active vehicles placed into VehiclePtrArray
local_names.v1: vehicle-struct scan pointer, advancing 4656 dwords per step
local_names.v2: fill pointer into VehiclePtrArray during backfill
local_names.v3: candidate vehicle pointer tested during backfill
local_names.v4: scan pointer over VehiclePtrArray while checking for duplicates
local_names.v5: array index used in the final index-matching loop

operations.description: Scan the vehicle array from its base unk_5EC6D8 to byte_7C54D8 (VehicleArrayEnd) in steps of 4656 dwords, the vehicle-struct stride.
Skip the vehicle when its dword at index 3250 equals -1, i.e. the slot is not live.
Append the active vehicle pointer into dword_7C54F0 (VehiclePtrArray) at index v0 and increment v0.
Only when fewer than 104 vehicles were collected, clear the unused tail of VehiclePtrArray.
Zero 4 * (104 - v0) bytes starting at 4 * v0 + 8148208, i.e. the empty tail of dword_7C54F0 spanning up to byte_7C5690.
Backfill: for each empty slot rescan every vehicle from unk_5EC6D8 (stride 18624 bytes) up to byte_7C54D8, and skip any pointer already stored in dword_7C54F0, using byte_7C5690 as the scan bound.
Duplicate guard: a vehicle already present in dword_7C54F0 is not appended again; advance to the next vehicle candidate instead.
Write the first not-yet-listed vehicle pointer into the empty backfill slot and advance the fill pointer.
Initialize dword_7C54DC and dword_7C54E4 to 0 before the index-matching scan, so a reference pointer not found in the array leaves its index at 0.
Walk the built array: when entry v5 equals dword_7C54E0 store v5 into dword_7C54DC (CurrentPlayerIndex), and when it equals dword_7C54E8 store v5 into dword_7C54E4 (CurrentVehicleIndex).
Return v0, the number of active vehicles placed in VehiclePtrArray.

clean_pseudocode: if (v0 < 104) { memset((char*)dword_7C54F0 + 4 * v0, 0, 4 * (104 - v0)); for each empty slot append the first vehicle (from &unk_5EC6D8, stride 18624 bytes) not already in dword_7C54F0; }
for (v5 = 0; v5 < v0; v5++) { if (dword_7C54F0[v5] == dword_7C54E0) dword_7C54DC = v5; if (dword_7C54F0[v5] == dword_7C54E8) dword_7C54E4 = v5; }
